Perform the monthly maintenance procedure from step 2 to step 9, in
 addition to the following steps:
Disconnect AC supply to battery charger.

Read and record overall battery voltage immediately after AC power has
 been disconnected and then after fifteen (15) minutes for the duration of
 one hour continue recording the voltage every hour for light (8) hours
 while observing at the same lime that the voltage does not fall bellow 48
 volts.

If voltage fall below 48 volts, place battery bank on float (high)
 charge for eight (8) hours.

Place selector switch to trickle (normal) charge compare the readings
 you have taken to the reading recorded in previous years.

Batteries | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection 
 I3, which must be performed on 
an annually basis 
 as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, qualified maintenance 
 staff carry the suitable safety ID category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,
Use standard personal safety 
 and healthy
 equipment 
 as helmet, safety shoes, 
 goggles, protective clothing, rubber gloves
Don't smoke in the battery room.
Don't place any tools on top of battery cells (Danger of short circuit).
Never use the same tools on alkaline cells, you may have used on acid
 cells.
All tools will be used must be insulated.
Tools and Equipment
Standard
 personal safety and healthy equipment
Work to be Carried out
Perform the monthly maintenance procedure from step 2 to step 9, in
 addition to the following steps:
Disconnect AC supply to battery charger.
Read and record overall battery voltage immediately after AC power has
 been disconnected and then after fifteen (15) minutes for the duration of
 one hour continue recording the voltage every hour for light (8) hours
 while observing at the same lime that the voltage does not fall bellow 48
 volts.
If voltage fall below 48 volts, place battery bank on float (high)
 charge for eight (8) hours.
Place selector switch to trickle (normal) charge compare the readings
 you have taken to the reading recorded in previous years.
